headline: Mercury Ev-Tech submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: AGM voting results now on record
summary: Mercury Ev-Tech Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results from its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. This is a routine post-AGM compliance filing required for listed entities. Retail investors can review the voting outcomes for resolutions passed during the meeting. The filing has no direct impact on the company's financial performance or stock price.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no direct financial impact
